```{r}
model_colors <- c(
  "TWFE"    = "#1b9e77",
  "ETWFE"   = "#66c2a5",
  "RW"      = "#a6cee3",
  "RW-IID"  = "#1f78b4",
  "RW-ST"   = "#08306b",
  "GB-Ens"  = "#e69f00"
)

summary(psdt[measure == "RMSE", .(value)] )

plot_performance <- \(grp = "NonCore", measure_name =  "RMSE", year = "Year 4"
  , log_scale = TRUE
) {
  plot_dt <- psdt[nc == grp & measure == measure_name & s == year]

  if (log_scale) {
    ylab <- paste0(measure_name, " (log scale)")
    lower <- quantile(log(plot_dt$value), 0.005, na.rm = TRUE)
    upper <- quantile(log(plot_dt$value), 0.995, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    ylab <- measure_name
    lower <- 0
    upper <- quantile(plot_dt$value, 0.995, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  pp <- plot_dt |>
    ggplot(aes(y = value, x = model, fill = model)) +
    # Boxplots
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(lower, upper)) +
    # Faceting by dgp
    facet_grid(rmse_q ~ dgp, scales = "free_y") +
    # Formatting
    xlab("model") +
    ylab(ylab) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = model_colors) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  if (log_scale) {
    pp <- pp + scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10")
  }
  png(paste0("output/performance_plot_", grp, "_", ylab, ".png")
    , width = 480 * 5, height = 480 * 3, res = 300
  )
  pp
  dev.off()
  pp
}


#plot_performance("NonCore", "RMSE", log_scale = TRUE)
plot_performance("NonCore", "RMSE")
plot_performance("Core", "RMSE")

plot_performance("Core", "CRPS")

plot_performance("NonCore", "Interval Score")
plot_performance("Core", "Interval Score")
```

```{r}
# pp should contain one row per replication with columns:
# model, world, s (Year 0/Year 4), cvg (0/1)

cov_sum <- fits_avg[, .(
  n = .N,
  p = mean(cvg)     # estimated coverage
), by = .(dgp, s, model, nc)]

# Normal approx SE (fine at n=200); or use p*(1-p)/n
cov_sum[, se := sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n)]
cov_sum[, `:=`(lo = p - 1.96 * se, hi = p + 1.96 * se)]
cov_sum[, `:=`(lo = pmax(0, lo), hi = pmin(1, hi))]
cov_sum[, s := ordered(
  s
  , levels = 0:4
  , labels = paste0("Year ", 0:4)
)]

plot_cvg <- \(grp) {
  cp <- cov_sum[s %in% c("Year 0", "Year 4") & nc == grp] |>
    ggplot(aes(x = model, y = p, col = model)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = 2) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.15) +
    facet_grid(s ~ dgp) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(y = "Coverage (95% interval)", x = NULL) +
    scale_color_manual(values = model_colors) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  png(paste0("output/performance_plot_", grp, "_cvg.png")
    , width = 480 * 5, height = 480 * 3, res = 300
  )
  cp
  dev.off()
  cp
}

plot_cvg("NonCore")
plot_cvg("Core")
```

PLOTS
```{r}
gp4 <- \(.sdt, horiz = 0, loc = "NonCore") {
  # First prepare your data with both model and urb groups
  psdt <- .sdt[s == horiz & nc == loc
   , summ_score(.SD)
   , by = .(r, model)]

  psdt <- melt(psdt
    # ID variables to keep as is
    , id.vars = c("r", "model")
    # Measure variables to convert to long format
    , measure.vars = c("se", "cvg", "crps", "intv")
    # Name of the new column identifying the measure
    , variable.name = "measure"
    # Name of the new column containing values
    , value.name = "value"
  )

  psdt[, measure := factor(
    measure
    , levels = c("se", "cvg", "crps", "intv")
    , labels = c("RMSE", "95% CI Coverage", "CRPS", "Interval Score")
  )]
  # Filter out extreme values
  # Calculate reference values PER URBAN CATEGORY
  forest_ref <- psdt[model == "twfe", .(
    median_val = median(value),
    q25_val = quantile(value, .25),
    q75_val = quantile(value, .75)
  ), by = measure]

  forest_ref[measure == "95% CI Coverage", `:=`(
    median_val = .95
    , q25_val = .95
    , q75_val = .95
  )]

  # Create the faceted plot
  gp1 <- ggplot(psdt, aes(y = value, x = model, col = model)) +
    # Reference band from forest model - note we use forest_ref here
    geom_rect(data = forest_ref,
              aes(xmin = 0.1, xmax = 6.9,
                  ymin = q25_val, ymax = q75_val),
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
              fill = "lightgray", alpha = 0.3) +
    # Reference line for median
    geom_hline(data = forest_ref,
              aes(yintercept = median_val),
              linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray") +
    # Boxplots
    geom_boxplot() +
    # Faceting by urban category
    facet_wrap(measure ~ ., scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    # Formatting
    theme_minimal() +
    xlab("model") +
    ylab("performace measure") +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  gp1
}
```

TABLES

```{r}
fmedian_iqr <- function(x, na.rm = TRUE) {
  q <- collapse::fquantile(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm = na.rm)
  # Format as "median (IQR)" string
  sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", q[2],  q[3] - q[1])
}

sdt_cum[, event_time := factor(event_time)]

sdt_cum[event_time %in% c(0, 2, 4) #& urb2 == "NonCore"
  , summ_score(.SD)
  , by = .(replication, urb2, event_time, model)
][order(-urb2, event_time, model)
  , lapply(.SD, fmedian_iqr)
  , by = .(urb2, event_time, model)
  , .SDcols = is.numeric
] |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 3) |>
  gtsave("output/performance_table.html")
```
